text: [menacing][hesitant] ... So humanity's little fleet has finally come this far. Breaking a century of silence.
[menacing] A hundred years ago, I sealed your star. I believed your species' silence would be eternal. And yet — one capsule has awoken again.
[menacing] Yi Sun-sin. Your tactical data was the heart of my defensive algorithm. I sealed you — to strip away the strongest weapon.
[menacing][hesitant] Einstein, too... The old scholar I cast into the rift a century ago, still alive. How intriguing.
[menacing] Eisenklaue. Your duty was the blockade. And you failed the blockade. Excuses — I do not accept.
[menacing][hesitant] ... My escort has fallen. But my core barrier cannot be pierced by any weapon. What is it — that you possess?
[menacing][hesitant] (shaken for the first time) That is... spacetime resonance? Impossible. With natural crystals, you cannot...
[menacing][hesitant] (signal fading) Humanity... you... have risen... again... The blockade... could never... have been... eternal...
